title: Pin Perak Lima Puluh
genre: Malay symphonic progressive rock (1970s Mellotron-and-organ prog)
subject: A retired railway signalman in Kuala Lipis who has given blood every four months for thirteen years is about to receive the silver pin for his fiftieth donation and wonders who carries it.
caption: Malay symphonic progressive rock, 1970s style with a stately mid-tempo pulse. Mellotron strings holding long chords, Hammond organ playing rising runs, electric guitar with a clean singing lead tone, fretless bass moving under the melody, drum kit with open toms and ride cymbal. Analog tape warmth, wide stereo organ, dry drums. Male vocal, warm baritone, clearly sung. 92 BPM, A minor. Reflective, steady, quietly proud. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. No synth pop, no trap drums, no autotune, no rap, no EDM, no distorted metal guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - Mellotron strings and organ, clean guitar]

[Verse 1]
Empat bulan sekali aku datang
Ke kaunter putih dekat stesen lama
Jari ditusuk, lengan disingsing
Jururawat sudah hafal namaku

[Pre-Chorus]
Beg merah itu berat sedikit
Lima puluh kali, kuhitung semua

[Chorus]
Ke mana perginya darahku
Ke tangan siapa, ke wad mana
Tak pernah kukenal nama itu
Namun dia berjalan bawa sebahagianku

[Verse 2]
Dulu aku tukar lampu isyarat
Hijau untuk kereta api lalu
Kini kutukar pula satu degup
Dari lenganku ke dada yang lain

[Pre-Chorus]
Pin perak kecil di atas meja
Jururawat senyum, aku tunduk

[Chorus]
Ke mana perginya darahku
Mungkin ke budak yang baru bangun
Tak pernah kukenal nama itu
Namun lampu hijau menyala untukku

[Outro - organ and Mellotron, slow guitar line]
Empat bulan lagi aku datang
Simpan satu kerusi untukku
